entries.title: Uncaptioned figures in PDFs can often be recovered
entries.body: When you add a PDF, the app can often find and show a figure that has no caption, where before it left a note saying the picture was missing. If it still cannot find one, the note stays as it was. Articles you added earlier are not updated automatically.

entries.title: Structure copes with more faulty AI answers
entries.body: Structure, the outline of an article's sections, could fail to build on long PDFs and other articles, and modes that rely on it, such as Quotes and Ideas, would not open. Some faulty lines in the AI's answer no longer sink the whole outline, though a few sections may be left out, their text kept with the section before.

entries.title: Dictation records from your first word
entries.body: In Chrome and Edge, when you dictated into a text box, the first moment of what you said could go unrecorded. Recording starts as soon as the microphone is open, and until then a note asks you to wait. A specific error, such as a disconnected microphone, is no longer replaced by a vaguer one.
